value.rationale: This solves a natural and materially consequential schedule-design question: whether fair deterministic rotation can replace independent source selection while improving discounted search success. A universal four-mode bound and sharp five-mode physical obstruction identify exactly where the intuitive comparison principle fails, with rigorous all-mode extension and a reproducible rational Brownian example. It is not a mere textbook derivation or arbitrary finite slice.
